payload.artist_html: Matthew C. Herne, Jay P. Nair, Alistair R. Evans and Alan M. Tait
payload.description_html: Comparisons of Australian ornithopod maxillary tooth crowns in left labial view: (1, 2) Atlascopcosaurus loadsi Rich and Rich, 1989 (NMV P157390), m5’ (counted from posterior end) and schematic (2); (3) Victorian ornithopodan maxillary morphotype 4 (cf. Atlascopcosaurus loadsi; NMV P208133), schematic of right m3’ (reversed; counted from posterior end); (4) Galleonosaurus dorisae n. gen. n. sp., schematic of holotypic (NMV P229196) m8; (5, 6) Leaellynasaura amicagraphica Rich and Rich, 1989, holotypic (NMV P185991) m5–m12 with schematic of m9 (6); (7) Muttaburrasaurus sp. (QM F14921), schematic of left ~m4’ (counted from posterior end). 1abr = primary apicobasal ridge; 2abr = secondary apicobasal ridge; cv = cingular vertex; cvr = convergent (secondary) ridge; dbr = distal bounding ridge; ldc = lingulate denticle; mbr = mesial bounding ridge; rt = root. Scale bars: 10 mm (7); 5 mm (5); 1 mm (1–4, 6).
